meta.name: xlsx
meta.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能直接打开、编辑、修复或创建 Excel、CSV 等表格文件。它会用公式而非硬编码，并自动检查公式错误。
howto.when: 当你提到一个表格文件（如 .xlsx、.csv）的名称或路径，并要求对它进行读写、编辑、转换或清理时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开下载文件夹里的销售数据.xlsx，看看第一张表。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并预览数据。

say.text: 给这个表格加一列总价，用公式计算数量×单价。
say.note: Claude 会添加公式并重新计算。

say.text: 把这个 CSV 文件转成格式规范的 Excel，并修复错位的列。
say.note: Claude 会清理数据并生成 .xlsx。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can open, edit, fix, or create spreadsheet files (.xlsx, .csv, etc.). It uses formulas instead of hardcoded values and automatically checks for formula errors.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention a spreadsheet file name or path and ask to read, edit, convert, or clean it.

say_en.text: Open the sales data.xlsx in my downloads and show me the first sheet.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file and preview data.

say_en.text: Add a total column with formula =quantity*unit price.
say_en.note: Claude will add the formula and recalculate.

say_en.text: Convert this CSV to a well-formatted Excel and fix misaligned columns.
say_en.note: Claude will clean data and produce .xlsx.
